name: mcp-servers
description: MCP servers for Jira, Confluence, and Azure DevOps integration with GitHub Copilot
author: Sean Rowe <sean.rowe@accucodeai.com>

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix jira-mcp-server && npm install --prefix confluence-mcp-server && npm install --prefix azure-mcp-server
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix jira-mcp-server && npm run build --prefix confluence-mcp-server && npm run build --prefix azure-mcp-server
scripts.clean: rm -rf jira-mcp-server/node_modules jira-mcp-server/dist confluence-mcp-server/node_modules confluence-mcp-server/dist azure-mcp-server/node_modules azure-mcp-server/dist
